Definition: the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color (violet) obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith
BiblicalUsage: 1) violet, violet stuff; 1a) violet thread; 1b) violet stuff or fabric; 2) (TWOT) blue (covering spectrum from brilliant red through deep purple)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
